author: Desmond
name: PlayerStats
install_msg:
Thank you for installing PlayerStats!
Do `[p]playerstats` to generate a line chart of the online players from the Eadventure logs API. Use `[p]setplayerstats` to configure the time range and the title.
short: Generate a line chart of the players online, from the Eadventure logs API.
description: Generate a line chart of the players online, from the Eadventure logs API. The time range and the chart title are configurable per server.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users.
